discourse.excerpt: It is easy to conquer anger through love, attachment through reasoning, falsehood through truth, bad thoughts through good and greed through charity.
discourse.theme: Anger is conquered through love, falsehood through truth, greed through charity — and the devotee who holds God in his heart is the supremest in creation.
discourse.title: Beacon in the dark

reflection: Swami says peace and joy are already in our possession, like money forgotten in a book — the Guru only reveals the treasure within. And the devotee who holds God in his heart is the supremest in creation. Today, act as if the treasure is already yours: face one worry with the calm of someone who already has what they need. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 7 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Share one rule of right living with someone younger — by example, not lecture — the way the ancient teachings were passed on.
